Read the PDF file at {PDF_PATH} (a scanned U.S. House Periodic Transaction Report). Extract every transaction listed in the table into a JSON array. If the scan quality makes a value illegible or ambiguous, still make your best reading rather than omitting the transaction, but you may set an individual field to null if it is truly unreadable.

For each transaction include exactly these fields:
- owner: one of "self", "spouse", "joint", "child", or null
- asset_description_raw: string, the full asset description text as printed
- ticker: string or null
- asset_type: 2-letter code like ST/OP/GS/MF or null
- option_type: "call" or "put" or null (only for option transactions)
- strike: float or null (only for option transactions)
- expiry: ISO yyyy-mm-dd or null (only for option transactions)
- tx_type: one of "purchase", "sale_full", "sale_partial", "exchange"
- tx_date: ISO yyyy-mm-dd
- notification_date: ISO yyyy-mm-dd
- amount_min: float
- amount_max: float

Output ONLY the JSON array as your final answer. No markdown code fences, no other text.
